caption:
Five minutes, or one hour. Same lead. Same offer. Same price. Completely different odds of closing.

Speed to lead is the cheapest thing in your business to fix and almost nobody measures it.

It does not appear on any report your agency sends. It appears in revenue you never knew you lost, because the person booked someone who answered first.

Three questions worth asking today:
→ How long does a lead actually wait for a reply?
→ Who answers when you're on a job?
→ What happens to the ones who don't pick up the first time?

📌 Send this to someone whose phone is full of leads they never called back.
